{{Top|leg}}
A '''Bothan [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] force''' enforced local law and handled the daily crime of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tal'cara]] on the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] colony [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. The station was located on the northern area of the city, next to the [[Imperial compound (Kothlis)|Imperial compound]].<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

The patrols consisted of three Bothans, armed with [[Stun gun/Legends|stun guns]], and sometimes used [[Arrow-23_landspeeder/Legends|Arrow-23]] [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeers]]. In emergencies during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Imperial troops were used.<ref name="guide" />
